findings.description: No AC defines what happens when a mount root does not exist or is not a directory at listen(): AC-1 only says the canonical root is computed at listen. The judgement condition says the same. A test cannot pin this behaviour.
findings.suggested_action: Decide during implementation (per CLAUDE.md undecided-item rule): either 404 per request or listen() failure, then record it in AC-1 and static.md.

findings.description: AC-4's 8192-byte part header line limit does not say whether the CRLF terminator counts. That changes the 8192/8193 boundary test.
findings.suggested_action: Add a Decision clause (e.g. the length excludes CRLF, matching the TinyHttpd header-line convention).

findings.description: AC-2 heap bound (also FR-STATIC-003 AC-4, 10.static-files.srs.md:315) uses System.gc() deltas, which can be flaky. The judgement already deducts for this and adds a fixed -Xmx isolation condition. The score stays above 80.
findings.suggested_action: Keep the condition and run in an isolated Gradle test task with fixed -Xmx.
